_comment: Hand-entered research inputs for the Dodgers international signing census audit. Every list here is a transcription of a page that was actually read; pages that could not be read are recorded under unreadable_sources with the reason, never guessed.

period_rules.pre_2019: July 2 to June 15 periods (label YYYY-YY). Dates June 16 to July 1 are outside any window and are assigned to the period that just closed, flagged OUTSIDE_WINDOW.
period_rules.2022+: January 15 to December 15 periods (label YYYY). Dates December 16 to January 14 are assigned to the next period, flagged PRE_OPEN (this matches the 2025 class, whose seven 2024-12-16 transactions were announced as part of the 29-player 2025 class).

official_or_secondary_lists.note: The page says the period began July 2 (2017) and runs through June 15, 2018: the 26 is the 2017-18 opening wave, not the completed 2016-17 period.
